notes: MACULA's glosses on כֻּלָּנָה are distributed in reverse order ('of.them' on כֹּל, 'all' on the suffix); the surface, lemma and morphology are what were read, exactly as rule 39 directs, so כֹּל takes 'all' and the suffix 'them'.
The ASV writes 'them all' rather than 'all of them', so rule 19's 'of + pronoun' unit does not arise.
עַל is unrepresented: the comparative recasting 'excellest them all' leaves its own relation unstated (rule 40).
The explicit pronoun אַתְּ takes 'thou' and the verb keeps only its lexical verb, a present pronoun holding the subject.
